## Changes
- Edit rendered Markdown text directly in Preview, while Edit continues to show the raw source. - Newly opened documents start protected. Use the toolbar padlock to enable writing or protect the draft again. - Save manually with Command-S; unsaved changes are explicitly marked. - Closing tabs, windows or the app offers Save, Discard and Cancel when changes are pending. - Preserve pending preview edits across conflict-copy saves, external changes and synchronization. - Document metadata now uses its heading color for the border.
## Distribution
Stable promotion of the owner-accepted beta 0.1.395, with unchanged application and dependency source. A higher numeric build lets Sparkle offer this stable package to existing beta installations.
macOS arm64. Developer ID signed, Apple notarized and Sparkle archive signature verified before publication. Updates install only on user action. The combined beta subscription also includes this stable release.
Hosted owner acceptance: https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/issues/15#issuecomment-6199258979
This publication does not install or restart the owner's application. Extended updater acceptance remains tracked in issue #15.
